# 🔍 English — Reflective Essay: Sharing Personal Insight

Grade 6, Week 26! Let's learn to write about our own thoughts and growth! 🔍

## 🔄 Review
We wrote a literary essay analyzing theme.

## 🔍 What Is a Reflective Essay?
A **reflective essay** shares the writer's personal thoughts, feelings, and insights about an experience or a piece of literature they've encountered.

## 📝 Key Elements
- Describe the **experience or text** briefly
- Share your **personal reaction** or feelings
- Explain what you **learned** or how you've grown

## ✍️ Example Starter
"When I read the story about the fisherman who lost everything, I realized..."

## 🔍 Difference from a Literary Essay
A literary essay analyzes the TEXT objectively; a reflective essay shares YOUR personal connection and growth from it.

## 🎯 Why This Matters
Reflective writing helps us process our experiences and understand our own thinking more deeply.

**Key words:** reflective essay, personal insight, experience, growth

# 🥧 Mathematics — Reading and Interpreting Pie Graphs

Grade 6, Week 26! Let's learn to read and understand pie graphs! 🥧

## 🔄 Review
We learned to calculate the area of a circle.

## 🥧 What Is a Pie Graph?
A **pie graph** (or pie chart) is a circular graph divided into slices, where each slice represents a percentage or proportion of the whole.

## 🔍 Reading a Pie Graph
- The whole circle represents **100%**
- Each slice's size shows its **percentage** of the total
- Larger slices mean a bigger proportion

## 📐 Angle and Percentage
Since a full circle is 360°, you can convert percentage to degrees: **degrees = percentage × 3.6**

**Example:** 25% of a pie graph = 25 × 3.6 = **90°**

## 🔍 Drawing Conclusions
When looking at a pie graph, we can compare slices to identify the largest category, smallest category, or make observations about the data.

**Key words:** pie graph, percentage, degrees, proportion

# 🌏 Science — Philippine Seasons and Earth's Rotation

Grade 6, Week 26! Let's learn why we experience day, night, and seasons! 🌏

## 🔄 Review
We learned about volcanoes and PHIVOLCS Alert Levels.

## 🌏 Earth's Rotation: Day and Night
The Earth **rotates** on its axis once every 24 hours, causing day and night as different parts face or turn away from the Sun.

## ☀️ Philippine Seasons
The Philippines experiences two main seasons:
- **Tag-init/Tag-araw (dry season)** — roughly March to May
- **Tag-ulan (wet/rainy season)** — roughly June to November

## 🔍 What Causes Seasons Globally?
Globally, seasons are caused by Earth's **tilted axis** as it revolves around the Sun, changing how directly sunlight hits different regions.

## 🎯 Why This Matters
Understanding Earth's rotation and seasons helps explain daily and yearly patterns that affect agriculture, weather, and daily life.

**Key words:** rotation, axis, revolution, tag-init, tag-ulan

# 📖 Filipino — Editoryal: Panimulang Kaalaman

Ang **editoryal** ay isang artikulong nagpapahayag ng opinyon ng patnugot o pahayagan tungkol sa isang isyu, karaniwang may layuning maghikayat o magpaalam.

**Mahahalagang salita:** editoryal, paninindigan, katibayan, opinyon

# 🌏 Araling Panlipunan — Pilipinas sa UN at ASEAN

Grade 6, Linggo 26! Alamin natin ang papel ng Pilipinas sa mga internasyonal na organisasyon! 🌏

## 🔄 Balik-Aral
Natutuhan natin ang Saligang Batas 1987.

## 🌏 Ano ang United Nations (UN)?
Ang **United Nations** ay isang internasyonal na organisasyon na nagsusulong ng kapayapaan, seguridad, at kooperasyon sa pagitan ng mga bansa. Miyembro ang Pilipinas dito mula pa noong 1945.

## 🤝 Ano ang ASEAN?
Ang **Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN)** ay isang samahan ng mga bansang Timog-Silangang Asya na naglalayong itaguyod ang kaunlaran at kapayapaan sa rehiyon. Kasapi ang Pilipinas dito mula 1967.

## 🌟 Kontribusyon ng Pilipinas
Aktibong lumalahok ang Pilipinas sa mga usaping pangkapayapaan, kalusugan, at karapatang pantao sa parehong organisasyon.

## 🎯 Bakit Mahalaga Ito?
Ang pakikilahok sa UN at ASEAN ay nagpapakita ng papel ng Pilipinas bilang responsableng bahagi ng internasyonal na komunidad.

**Mahahalagang salita:** United Nations, ASEAN, internasyonal na organisasyon, kooperasyon

# 🪵 EPP (IA) — Basic Wood Joints at Pagtatapos

Grade 6, Linggo 26! Simulan natin ang bagong sangay — Industrial Arts! 🪵

## 🔄 Balik-Aral
Natutuhan natin ang pagpapakete at pag-la-label ng produkto.

## 🪵 Ano ang Wood Joint?
Ang **wood joint** ay ang paraan ng pagdurugtong ng dalawang piraso ng kahoy o kawayan upang bumuo ng isang matibay na istruktura.

## 🔍 Mga Uri ng Wood Joint
- **Butt joint** — simpleng pagdikit ng dalawang dulo
- **Lap joint** — pagpapatong ng isang piraso sa ibabaw ng isa pa
- **Miter joint** — pagdurugtong sa anggulo, karaniwang 45°

## 🎨 Pagtatapos (Finishing)
Ang **pagtatapos** ay ang huling hakbang para protektahan at pagandahin ang kahoy, tulad ng pag-amplas at paglagay ng bernis o pintura.

## ⚠️ Kaligtasan
Gumamit lagi ng proteksyon sa mata kapag gumagamit ng mga kagamitan sa pagputol o pag-amplas.

**Mahahalagang salita:** wood joint, butt joint, lap joint, miter joint, pagtatapos
